headlines.description: The Philadelphia Eagles forced three turnovers while scoring four times during a nine-minute span in the second quarter, and they totaled nine sacks to beat the Miami Dolphins 26-10 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles' D tackles Dolphins as Vick wins in return
